blocks.chantTranslation:
\V. O God, come to my assistance.//\R. O Lord, make haste to help me.
Glory be...
O Lord our ruler,//you have clothed Birinus in glory//for all the length of days.
_Ps. 92_  The Lord reigns,//clothed in majesty;
the Lord is clothed with strength,//and has girded himself.

blocks.text:
1. Etenim firmávit orbem terræ, * qui non commovébitur.
  2. Paráta sedes tua ex tunc: * a sǽculo tu es.
  3. Elevavérunt flúmina, Dómine: * elevavérunt flúmina vocem suam.
  4. Elevavérunt flúmina fluctus suos, * a vócibus aquárum multárum.
  5. Mirábiles elatiónes maris: * mirábilis in altis Dóminus.
  6. Testimónia tua credibília facta sunt nimis: * domum tuam decet sanctitúdo, Dómine, in longitúdinem diérum.
  7. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
  8. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
blocks.translation:
1. For he has established the world, * which shall not be moved.
  2. Your throne is prepared from of old: * you are from everlasting.
  3. The floods have lifted up, O Lord: * the floods have lifted up their voice.
  4. The floods have lifted up their waves, * above the sound of many waters.
  5. Wonderful are the surges of the sea: * wonderful is the Lord on high.
  6. Your testimonies have been made exceedingly trustworthy: * holiness befits your house, O Lord, unto length of days.
  7. Glory be...

blocks.chantTranslation: O Lord our ruler,//you have clothed Birinus in glory//for all the length of days.
The Lord himself is the God in whose praises Birinus rejoices with gladness.
_Ps. 99_  Make a joyful noise to God,//all the earth://serve the Lord with gladness.

blocks.text:
1. Introíte in conspéctu eius, * in exsultatióne.
  2. Scitóte quóniam Dóminus ipse est Deus: * ipse fecit nos, et non ipsi nos.
  3. Pópulus eius, et oves páscuæ eius: † introíte portas eius in confessióne, * átria eius in hymnis: confitémini illi.
  4. Laudáte nomen eius: quóniam suávis est Dóminus, † in ætérnum misericórdia eius, * et usque in generatiónem et generatiónem véritas eius.
  5. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
  6. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
blocks.translation:
1. Enter into his presence * with rejoicing.
  2. Know that the Lord himself is God: * it is he who made us, and not we ourselves.
  3. We are his people, and the sheep of his pasture: † enter his gates with thanksgiving, * his courts with hymns: give thanks to him.
  4. Praise his name: for the Lord is sweet, † his mercy endures for ever, * and his truth from generation to generation.
  5. Glory be...

blocks.chantTranslation: The Lord himself is the God in whose praises Birinus rejoices with gladness.
Lord God, blessed Birinus //rejoices in you, for your right hand//has taken up his soul.
_Ps. 62_  O God, my God,//to you I watch from the dawn.

blocks.text:
1. Sitívit in te ánima mea, * quam multiplíciter tibi caro mea.
  2. In terra desérta, et ínvia, et inaquósa: † sic in sancto appárui tibi, * ut vidérem virtútem tuam, et glóriam tuam.
  3. Quóniam mélior est misericórdia tua super vitas: * lábia mea laudábunt te.
  4. Sic benedícam te in vita mea: * et in nómine tuo levábo manus meas.
  5. Sicut ádipe et pinguédine repleátur ánima mea: * et lábiis exsultatiónis laudábit os meum.
  6. Si memor fui tui super stratum meum, † in matutínis meditábor in te: * quia fuísti adiútor meus.
  7. Et in velaménto alárum tuárum exsultábo, † adhǽsit ánima mea post te: * me suscépit déxtera tua.
  8. Ipsi vero in vanum quæsiérunt ánimam meam, † introíbunt in inferióra terræ: * tradéntur in manus gládii, partes vúlpium erunt.
  9. Rex vero lætábitur in Deo, † laudabúntur omnes qui iurant in eo: * quia obstrúctum est os loquéntium iníqua.
  10. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
  11. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
blocks.translation:
1. My soul has thirsted for you, * and my flesh longs for you in many ways.
  2. In a desert land, and in a place without water and without path, † so have I appeared before you in the sanctuary, * that I might see your power and your glory.
  3. For your mercy is better than life: * my lips shall praise you.
  4. So will I bless you in my life: * and in your name I will lift up my hands.
  5. My soul shall be filled as with marrow and fatness: * and my mouth shall praise you with joyful lips.
  6. If I have remembered you upon my bed, † I will meditate on you in the morning watches: * because you have been my helper.
  7. And under the shadow of your wings I will rejoice; † my soul has clung to you: * your right hand has upheld me.
  8. But they have sought my soul in vain, † they shall go down into the depths of the earth: * they shall be delivered into the hands of the sword, they shall be the portion of foxes.
  9. But the king shall rejoice in God; † all who swear by him shall be praised: * for the mouth of those who speak wicked things shall be stopped.
  10. Glory be...

blocks.chantTranslation: Lord God, blessed Birinus //rejoices in you, for your right hand//has taken up his soul.
Birinus blesses the Lord of all creation who made him glorious; let us too praise and exalt him above all things.
_Can. Tri. Pue._  Bless the Lord,//all you works of the Lord://praise and exalt him above all for ever.

blocks.text:
1. Benedícite, Ángeli Dómini, Dómino: * benedícite, cæli, Dómino.
  2. Benedícite, aquæ omnes, quæ super cælos sunt, Dómino: * benedícite, omnes virtútes Dómini, Dómino.
  3. Benedícite, sol et luna, Dómino: * benedícite, stellæ cæli, Dómino.
  4. Benedícite, omnis imber et ros, Dómino: * benedícite, omnes spíritus Dei, Dómino.
  5. Benedícite, ignis et æstus, Dómino: * benedícite, frigus et æstus, Dómino.
  6. Benedícite, rores et pruína, Dómino: * benedícite, gelu et frigus, Dómino.
  7. Benedícite, glácies et nives, Dómino: * benedícite, noctes et dies, Dómino.
  8. Benedícite, lux et ténebræ, Dómino: * benedícite, fúlgura et nubes, Dómino.
  9. Benedícat terra Dóminum: * laudet et superexáltet eum in sǽcula.
  10. Benedícite, montes et colles, Dómino: * benedícite, univérsa germinántia in terra, Dómino.
  11. Benedícite, fontes, Dómino: * benedícite, mária et flúmina, Dómino.
  12. Benedícite, cete, et ómnia, quæ movéntur in aquis, Dómino: * benedícite, omnes vólucres cæli, Dómino.
  13. Benedícite, omnes béstiæ et pécora, Dómino: * benedícite, fílii hóminum, Dómino.
  14. Benedícat Israël Dóminum: * laudet et superexáltet eum in sǽcula.
  15. Benedícite, sacerdótes Dómini, Dómino: * benedícite, servi Dómini, Dómino.
  16. Benedícite, spíritus, et ánimæ iustórum, Dómino: * benedícite, sancti, et húmiles corde, Dómino.
  17. Benedícite, Ananía, Azaría, Mísaël, Dómino: * laudáte et superexaltáte eum in sǽcula.
  18. Benedicámus Patrem et Fílium cum Sancto Spíritu: * laudémus et superexaltémus eum in sǽcula.
  19. Benedíctus es, Dómine, in firmaménto cæli: * et laudábilis, et gloriósus, et superexaltátus in sǽcula.
blocks.translation:
1. Bless the Lord, angels of the Lord: * bless the Lord, heavens.
  2. Bless the Lord, waters above the heavens: * bless the Lord, all powers of the Lord.
  3. Bless the Lord, sun and moon: * bless the Lord, stars of heaven.
  4. Bless the Lord, rain and dew: * bless the Lord, all spirits of God.
  5. Bless the Lord, fire and heat: * bless the Lord, cold and heat.
  6. Bless the Lord, dews and hoarfrost: * bless the Lord, ice and cold.
  7. Bless the Lord, ice and snow: * bless the Lord, nights and days.
  8. Bless the Lord, light and darkness: * bless the Lord, lightning and clouds.
  9. Let the earth bless the Lord: * let it praise and exalt him above all for ever.
  10. Bless the Lord, mountains and hills: * bless the Lord, all growths upon the earth.
  11. Bless the Lord, springs: * bless the Lord, seas and rivers.
  12. Bless the Lord, whales and all that move in the waters: * bless the Lord, all birds of the air.
  13. Bless the Lord, beasts and cattle: * bless the Lord, sons of men.
  14. Let Israel bless the Lord: * let it praise and exalt him above all for ever.
  15. Bless the Lord, priests of the Lord: * bless the Lord, servants of the Lord.
  16. Bless the Lord, spirits and souls of the just: * bless the Lord, holy and humble of heart.
  17. Bless the Lord, Ananias, Azarias, Misael: * praise and exalt him above all for ever.
  18. Let us bless the Father and the Son with the Holy Spirit: * let us praise and exalt him above all for ever.
  19. Blessed are you, O Lord, in the firmament of heaven: * and worthy of praise, and glorious, and exalted above all for ever.

blocks.chantTranslation: Birinus blesses the Lord of all creation who made him glorious; let us too praise and exalt him above all things.
Let us praise on earth the Lord of heaven, in whose glory//Birinus exults with all the saints://may he intercede for us.
_Ps. 148_  Praise the Lord from the//heavens: praise him in the heights.

blocks.text:
1. Laudáte eum, omnes Angeli eius: * laudáte eum, omnes virtútes eius.
  2. Laudáte eum, sol et luna: * laudáte eum, omnes stellæ et lumen.
  3. Laudáte eum, cæli cælórum: * et aquæ omnes, quæ super cælos sunt, laudent nomen Dómini.
  4. Quia ipse dixit, et facta sunt: * ipse mandávit, et creáta sunt.
  5. Státuit ea in ætérnum, et in sǽculum sǽculi: * præcéptum pósuit, et non præteríbit.
  6. Laudáte Dóminum de terra, * dracónes, et omnes abýssi.
  7. Ignis, grando, nix, glácies, spíritus procellárum: * quæ fáciunt verbum eius:
  8. Montes, et omnes colles: * ligna fructífera, et omnes cedri.

  9. Béstiæ, et univérsa pécora: * serpéntes, et vólucres pennátæ:
  10. Reges terræ, et omnes pópuli: * príncipes, et omnes iúdices terræ.
  11. Júvenes, et vírgines, † senes cum iunióribus laudent nomen Dómini: * quia exaltátum est nomen eius solíus.
  12. Conféssio eius super cælum et terram: * et exaltávit cornu pópuli sui.
  13. Hymnus ómnibus sanctis eius: * fíliis Israël, pópulo appropinquánti sibi.
  14. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
  15. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
blocks.translation:
1. Praise him, all you his angels: * praise him, all his powers.
  2. Praise him, sun and moon: * praise him, all you stars and light.
  3. Praise him, you heavens of heavens: * and let all waters that are above the heavens praise the name of the Lord.
  4. For he spoke, and they were made: * he commanded, and they were created.
  5. He has established them for ever and ever: * he has set a decree, and it shall not pass away.
  6. Praise the Lord from the earth, * you dragons and all deeps.
  7. Fire, hail, snow, ice, stormy winds: * which fulfil his word;
  8. Mountains and all hills: * fruitful trees and all cedars;


  9. Beasts and all cattle: * creeping things and flying birds;
  10. Kings of the earth and all peoples: * princes and all judges of the earth;
  11. Young men and maidens, † old men with the younger, * let them praise the name of the Lord. For his name alone is exalted:
  12. His praise is above heaven and earth. * and he has raised up the horn of his people: 
  13. A hymn for all his saints, for the children of Israel, a people drawing near to him.
  14. Glory be...

blocks.chantTranslation: Let us praise on earth the Lord of heaven, in whose glory//Birinus exults with all the saints://may he intercede for us.

blocks.chantTranslation:
Jesu, the world’s Redeemer,//the bishops’ fadeless crown,
The prayers and praises that we pay,//Accept with gentlest love today.
The meek confessor of your name//Today attained a glorious fame;
Whose yearly feast, in solemn state,//Your faithful people celebrate.
The world and all its boasted good,//As vain and passing, he eschewed;
And therefore with angelic bands,//In endless joy forever stands.
Grant then that we, O gracious God,//May follow in the steps he trod:
And, at his prayer, thy servants free//From stain of all iniquity.
O Christ, most holy King,//and to the Father be the Glory,
with the Spirit Paraclete//for eternal ages. Amen.

\V. The Lord led the righteous man//by straight paths.
\R. And showed him//the kingdom of God.

Light arising in the darkness,//lighten us through the merits of Birinus with which you are pleased,
and lead us in the paths of peace//to the praise of your name.
_Can. Zac._  Blessed be the Lord//God of Israel,
For he has visited and redeemed his people.

blocks.text:
1. Et eréxit cornu salútis nobis: * in domo David, púeri sui.
  2. Sicut locútus est per os sanctórum, * qui a sǽculo sunt, prophetárum eius:
  3. Salútem ex inimícis nostris, * et de manu ómnium, qui odérunt nos.
  4. Ad faciéndam misericórdiam cum pátribus nostris: * et memorári testaménti sui sancti.
  5. Jusiurándum, quod iurávit ad Abraham patrem nostrum, * datúrum se nobis:
  6. Ut sine timóre, de manu inimicórum nostrórum liberáti, * serviámus illi.
  7. In sanctitáte, et iustítia coram ipso, * ómnibus diébus nostris.
  8. Et tu, puer, Prophéta Altíssimi vocáberis: * præíbis enim ante fáciem Dómini, paráre vias eius:
  9. Ad dandam sciéntiam salútis plebi eius: * in remissiónem peccatórum eórum:
  10. Per víscera misericórdiæ Dei nostri: * in quibus visitávit nos, óriens ex alto:
  11. Illumináre his, qui in ténebris, et in umbra mortis sedent: * ad dirigéndos pedes nostros in viam pacis.
  12. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
  13. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
blocks.translation:
1. And has raised up a horn of salvation for us * in the house of David his servant,
  2. As he spoke by the mouth of his holy prophets, * who have been from of old:
  3. Salvation from our enemies, * and from the hand of all who hate us;
  4. To show mercy to our fathers, * and to remember his holy covenant,
  5. The oath which he swore to Abraham our father, * to grant unto us,
  6. That, being delivered from the hand of our enemies, * we might serve him without fear,
  7. In holiness and righteousness before him, * all our days.
  8. And you, child, shall be called the Prophet of the Most High; * for you shall go before the face of the Lord to prepare his ways,
  9. To give knowledge of salvation to his people * through the forgiveness of their sins,
  10. Through the tender mercy of our God, * whereby the Dayspring from on high has visited us,
  11. To give light to those who sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, * to guide our feet into the way of peace.
  12. Glory be...

blocks.chantTranslation:
Light arising in the darkness,//lighten us through the merits of Birinus with which you are pleased,
and lead us in the paths of peace//to the praise of your name.

blocks.chantTranslation:
\V. The Lord be with you.//\R. And with your spirit. Let us pray.
Grant, we beseech you, almighty God, that the venerable solemnity
of blessed Birinus,//your Confessor and Bishop,
may both increase our devotion //and secure for us salvation.
Through our Lord Jesus Christ...

\R. Amen.
\V. The Lord be with you.//\R. And with your spirit.

\V. Let us bless the Lord.
\R. Thanks be to God.

blocks.text: The officiant continues in a low voice:

blocks.chantTranslation:
\V. May the souls of the faithful, through the mercy of God,//rest in peace.
\R. Amen.
